NUPY · Mini 2 · questionsd1 · Robbins CNS · 103 questions

CNS pathology MCQs, tagged by subject.

Every question and answer from questionsd1 (Robbins Review of Pathology, chapter 28: Central Nervous System), with its figures, as two quizzes — the main questions and the online “e” questions. Each question is tagged with its subject and the NUPY lecture where the tested point is taught (or ross gap/not covered); filter by subject above the question. Use 💡 Hint before you answer. After you answer you get the doc’s explanation word for word, then a separate, clearly labelled AI explanation: the gist, why each wrong option is wrong, and buzzwords. Tap a figure to enlarge it. Progress stays in this browser.

Questions, figures, answers and explanations are reproduced verbatim from questionsd1.pdf (Robbins Review of Pathology, ch. 28) for your own revision; PBD10/BP10 page references are the book’s. Hints, AI explanations and the subject/lecture tags are generated and marked as such. The page is AES-GCM encrypted; the source PDF is not in this repository.
